summary: The height of each line of text, which sets the space between lines.
details: A unitless number multiplies the element’s own font size, and children inherit the number, so it scales correctly for every size. Body text reads best around 1.4–1.6; large headings want less, around 1.1–1.2.

values.note: Default: about 1.2, depends on the font.
Fixed: does not follow the font size.

gotcha: A length (24px, 1.5em) is computed once and inherited as that length, so a larger heading inside gets cramped lines. Prefer the unitless number.
